Nothing is uploaded: what CruxCoach reads stays in its encrypted database on this phone, and what it writes goes only to Health Connect on this phone.
CruxCoach can exchange the following with Health Connect – each part only after you switch it on in the training settings and allow it:
Read: sleep sessions of last night – shown as a suggestion for the sleep score in your daily check-in. Nothing is saved without you.
Read: exercise sessions marked as climbing – added as climbing days, so the coach knows about gym, rock and other boards.

Write: what you log in nutrition – each food with its name, meal, energy, protein, carbohydrate and fat, and each glass of water – so other apps you allow can use it. Changed or deleted entries are updated there.
CruxCoach reads nothing else and writes nothing else.
Everything else stays on your device in the encrypted training database. Nothing is sent to a server.
You can switch each part off in the training settings and revoke access in Health Connect at any time. Data already written stays in Health Connect until you delete it there.
